title: ScienceAgentBench: Toward Rigorous Assessment of Language Agents for Data-Driven Scientific Discovery
authors_zh: Ziru Chen、Shijie Chen、Yuting Ning、Qianheng Zhang、Boshi Wang、Botao Yu、Yifei Li、Zeyi Liao、Chen Wei、Zitong Lu、Vishal Dey、Mingyi Xue、Frazier N. Baker、Benjamin Burns、Daniel Adu-Ampratwum、Xuhui Huang、Xia Ning、Song Gao、Yu Su、Huan Sun
best_for_zh: 需要使用专家题目、评审或评分信号评测推理系统的研究者。
one_line: ScienceAgentBench rigorously evaluates data-tool-using language agents on expert-validated scientific discovery tasks.
以专家验证的科学发现任务，严谨评测可调用数据工具的语言 Agent。
why: It makes expert-grounded evaluation evidence and its audit boundary visible.
inclusion_reason: The release supplies expert-authored, rubric-, judgment-, or reference-grounded evidence for evaluating reasoning systems.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Scientific-agent benchmarks often use toy analyses or score only final numbers and do not test whether models understand authentic research goals, choose data-processing steps, write executable programs, and produce correct artefacts. Without expert validation, tasks may be irreproducible or ambiguous.

ScienceAgentBench reconstructs data-driven tasks from peer-reviewed papers and uses self-contained Python programs, execution outputs, and expert validation as acceptance criteria.

科学 Agent benchmark 常用玩具数据分析题或只判断最终数字，无法评价模型能否理解真实论文中的科学目标、选择数据处理步骤、编写可运行程序并生成正确分析产物。缺少领域专家验证还会导致任务本身不可复现或答案不唯一。

ScienceAgentBench 从同行评议论文中恢复数据驱动研究任务，以自包含 Python 程序、执行结果和专家验证作为验收标准。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ScienceAgentBench contains 102 tasks reconstructed from forty-four peer-reviewed papers across four scientific disciplines and validated by nine subject-matter experts. Agents must generate executable Python programs for authentic analyses, and evaluation covers code, execution artefacts, cost, and independent success. Hugging Face mainly hosts the annotation sheet, while data and environments are provided through the project repository; a verified split was added in 2026.

ScienceAgentBench 含 102 个任务，来源于 44 篇同行评议论文，覆盖四个科学学科，并由九名 subject-matter experts 多轮验证。每题要求 Agent 生成可执行 Python 程序以完成真实数据分析，评价代码、运行产物、成本和自主完成率。HF 主要发布 annotation sheet；完整数据与环境通过项目仓库获取，2026 年另发布 verified split。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select scientific papers: Papers with public data, reproducible workflows, and clear analytical objectives are selected across four disciplines.
  1. Reconstruct tasks: Paper methods are converted into task descriptions, data assets, target outputs, and reference Python programs.
  1. Validate with experts: Nine domain experts review scientific validity, data, code, and outputs and revise ambiguous or non-independent tasks.
  1. Evaluate in sandboxes: Agents code and execute under fixed environments and attempt limits; verified splits, dependencies, budgets, and data versions must be fixed.

1. 筛选科研论文： 作者选择公开数据、可复现实验流程和明确分析目标的论文，覆盖四个学科。
  1. 重建自包含任务： 研究人员把论文方法转成任务描述、数据资产和目标输出，并编写参考 Python 程序。
  1. 多轮专家验证： 九名领域专家检查科学合理性、数据、代码和结果，修订无法独立完成或标准不清的任务。
  1. 隔离环境评测： Agent 在固定环境和尝试次数内编程并运行；复现需使用 verified split、固定依赖、预算和数据版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html: In the initial experiments, the best agent independently solves only 32.4% of tasks within three attempts; even with expert-provided knowledge, success reaches only 34.3%. The bottleneck is therefore not just background retrieval but analytical planning, implementation, and debugging. A 2026 verified split reduces evaluator false negatives and should be used with an explicit version.
初始实验中，最佳 Agent 在三次尝试内仅独立解决 32.4% 的任务；即使提供专家整理的知识，成功率也只有 34.3%，说明瓶颈不只是检索背景，而在分析规划、代码实现和执行调试。2026 年 verified split 用于减少 evaluator 假阴性，因此复现时应优先采用更新划分并注明版本。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Scientific QA checks knowledge answers, while coding-agent benchmarks focus on software repositories. ScienceAgentBench converts authentic paper analyses into end-to-end executable tasks and has experts validate both scientific questions and programs. The novelty is scientific workflow with executable and expert acceptance.
现有科学 QA 检查知识答案，代码 Agent benchmark 又多聚焦软件仓库。ScienceAgentBench 将真实论文中的数据分析目标恢复为端到端可执行任务，并由领域专家同时验证科学问题与程序。新意是科学发现工作流和双重可执行/专家验收。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: The 102 tasks from forty-four papers do not cover wet labs or long research cycles.
  1. Limitation 2: Environment and dependency changes can alter reference programs and evaluators, requiring pinned containers.
  1. Limitation 3: The public annotation sheet is not the complete task asset bundle, so access and licences require checking.

1. 局限1： 102 个任务来自 44 篇论文，不能覆盖实验科学、湿实验或长期研究循环。
  1. 局限2： 环境与依赖更新会导致参考程序和 evaluator 漂移，必须固定容器。
  1. 局限3： 公开 annotation sheet 不等于完整任务资产，数据获取与许可证需逐项检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Evaluate scientific agents on planning, code generation, execution debugging, and reproducibility.
  1. Use case 2: Use reference programs and artefacts to train scientific-workflow verifiers.
  1. Use case 3: Report independent and expert-knowledge settings separately and pin the verified split.

1. 使用场景1： 评测科学 Agent 的分析规划、代码生成、执行调试和结果复现。
  1. 使用场景2： 将参考程序和中间产物用于训练 scientific workflow verifier。
  1. 使用场景3： 使用时应报告 independent 与 expert-knowledge 两种设置，并固定 verified split。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Reconstruct 102 executable data-science tasks from real papers.
  2. Method: Forty-four papers, four disciplines, reference programs, nine experts, and sandbox execution.
  3. Data: HF provides an annotation sheet; project assets and a verified split are managed separately.
  4. Evidence: Best agent succeeds independently on 32.4%, and 34.3% with expert knowledge.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for scientific agents; pin containers, data, and evaluator versions.

1. 一句话定位： 从真实论文重建 102 个可执行数据科学任务。
  2. 方法抓手： 44 篇论文、四学科、参考程序、九名专家和隔离执行。
  3. 数据抓手： HF 提供 annotation sheet，完整资产由项目仓库管理，并有 verified split。
  4. 证据锚点： 最佳 Agent 独立成功 32.4%，给专家知识后仅 34.3%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合科学 Agent；必须固定容器、数据和 evaluator 版本。
